name: THREE GUYS Citrus Wash & Gloss Car Shampoo – High Foam Snow Foam Car Wash for Deep Cleaning & Shine
description: THREE GUYS Citrus Wash & Gloss is a German-engineered, high-suds car shampoo designed to deliver professional-level cleaning and gloss. Made with natural citrus-based cleaning agents, it creates a rich foam that safely lifts away dirt, grime, and road film while enhancing your car’s paint with a deep, wet-look shine.Key Features: • High Suds Formula: Thick foam for effective dirt removal and paint protection. • Brilliant Gloss Finish: Adds a vibrant, mirror-like shine after every wash. • Citrus-Based Formula: Natural cleaning power that’s safe and eco-friendly. • Safe for Waxed Paint: Maintains and enhances wax or sealant layers. • Hyper-Concentrated: A small amount provides maximum cleaning performance. • Scratch-Free Cleaning: Helps prevent swirl marks during washing. • Versatile Application: Works with foam cannon, gun, or bucket wash.How to Use: 1. Shake the bottle well before use. 2. Mix 1–3 oz of shampoo in a 5-gallon wash bucket or 32 oz foam cannon bottle. 3. Pre-rinse the car to remove loose dirt. 4. Apply foam using a foam cannon, foam gun, or wash mitt. 5. Gently wash with a microfiber mitt. 6. Rinse thoroughly and dry with a THREE GUYS Premium Microfiber Towel.Why Choose THREE GUYS Citrus Wash & Gloss? • Trusted German-engineered quality • Perfect for snow foam car wash setups • Enhances shine while protecting paint • Ideal for detailing enthusiasts and everyday users
